newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICA INDUSTRIALS EXTEND FALL ON FUTURES SELLING.
newsitem.headline: SAFRICA INDUSTRIALS EXTEND FALL ON FUTURES SELLING.

text.p: 1037 GMT - South African noon industrial shares whacked by futures selling as players cut long positions. Gold shares also weak on softer bullion price.
Dealers say market will remain weak in afternoon as players reluctant to take new positions ahead of the weekend.
* Investec confounds players as still running ahead. It adds 100 cents to 164 rand.
* Consmining most active share traded and whacked six cents to 75 cents as players struggle to understand complex relations with JCI and Saflife .
* Saflife also loses 15 cents to 18 rand.
* All-shares lose 33.4 points to 7,041.3, industrials drop 47.9 points to 8,270.0 and golds off 9.7 points to 1,171.9.
